classification.difficultyReason: Infer unlabelled lengths from differences and matching ticks, interpret the rotated L-shape, and choose a rectangle decomposition or subtraction before forming and simplifying perimeter and area expressions.

content.prompt: Find expressions, in simplest form, for the perimeter (P) and area (A) of these shapes.

spec.description: Upright unshaded concave hexagon with a rectangular notch removed from the bottom-right corner. Preserve horizontal and vertical edges, with no added right-angle marks.
spec.mathematics: Top side x; full left side x−2; upper right side x−3; lower-left horizontal side x−4. The unlabelled notch sides are 4 horizontally and 1 vertically. Diagram coordinates reproduce the source appearance rather than assigning a numerical value to x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions appear in the question figure. Derived dimensions and answers belong in the answer fields.

answer.worked:
The missing notch sides are $x-(x-4)=4$ and $(x-2)-(x-3)=1$.

$$\begin{align*}P&=2x+2(x-2)\\&=4x-4\end{align*}$$

Subtract the missing rectangle from the full rectangle.

$$\begin{align*}A&=x(x-2)-4(1)\\&=x^2-2x-4\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded L-shape with a horizontal arm across the top and a vertical arm descending on the right. Preserve the source orientation and unlabelled top and inner vertical sides.
spec.mathematics: Short left side 1; inner horizontal side x−1; full right side x; bottom side 2. The overall horizontal length is x+1 and the inner vertical length is x−1. Display coordinates preserve the source proportions without imposing a numerical x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source dimensions appear in the question figure.

answer.worked:
The top side is $(x-1)+2=x+1$. The inner vertical side is $x-1$.

$$\begin{align*}P&=2(x+1)+2x\\&=4x+2\end{align*}$$

Split the shape into the right-hand rectangle and the remaining top rectangle.

$$\begin{align*}A&=2x+1(x-1)\\&=3x-1\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded rotated rectilinear concave hexagon with its notch opening right. Clockwise vertices are top, upper-right shoulder, inward notch, lower-right shoulder, bottom and left. Both notch edges retain matching double ticks.
spec.mathematics: Top-to-upper-right-shoulder edge is 3; lower-right-shoulder-to-bottom edge is 4. Equal notch edges are both x, with x printed only beside the lower notch edge. The full outer dimensions are x+3 and x+4. Display geometry preserves the approximate source rotation and shape without assigning x a numerical value.
spec.answerVisibility: The question figure contains 3, 4, x and both double-tick pairs only. The corrected area is answer-only.

answer.worked:
The matching ticks show that both notch sides are $x$. The full outer side lengths are $x+3$ and $x+4$.

$$\begin{align*}P&=2(x+3)+2(x+4)\\&=4x+14\end{align*}$$

Split the shape into rectangles of dimensions $3$ by $x+4$ and $4$ by $x$.

$$\begin{align*}A&=3(x+4)+4x\\&=3x+12+4x\\&=7x+12\end{align*}$$
